    def _rebuild(self, reason: str) -> None:
        """Rebuild the whole sqlite index from the log.

        Clears ``facts`` and ``ticks`` only: ``store_meta`` survives, because
        ``own_lineage`` (which ``_decl.genesis`` row is *self*) is identity,
        not fact — it is not in the log and cannot be re-derived from it.

prev_row = self._conn.execute(
            f"SELECT {_TICK_ROW_SQL} FROM ticks ORDER BY rowid DESC LIMIT 1"
        ).fetchone()
        prev_hash = prev_row[6] if prev_row else None
        prev_cursor = prev_row[8] if prev_row else None

        edge_row = self._conn.execute(
            "SELECT id FROM facts ORDER BY rowid DESC LIMIT 1"
        ).fetchone()
        fact_cursor = edge_row[0] if edge_row else ""

        if prev_row is not None and prev_cursor is not None:
            window_start = prev_cursor
        else:
            window_start = fact_cursor  # pre-chain predecessor: epoch marker

        # Window hash commits to fact rows in (window_start, fact_cursor].
        window_hash = self._window_hash(window_start, fact_cursor)
